clips.title: The story
paras: Heeding the Call marks the moment an apprentice night elf druid catches the attention of the Cenarion Circle's senior leadership. Summoned to Darnassus to meet Mathrengyl Bearwalker, the young initiate begins the sacred path toward mastering their first animal aspect, the bear.

Novice druids honing their craft across Teldrassil—or studying abroad in far-off realms like Stormwind—eventually receive a personal summons. Instructors such as Kal in Dolanaar, Denatharion in Darnassus, or Theridran across the Great Sea carry word that Mathrengyl Bearwalker wishes to oversee their training personally. As the direct assistant to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, Mathrengyl is one of the most respected and knowledgeable mentors among the night elves, and his attention is an unmistakable sign that an apprentice is ready for genuine trials.

Reaching Mathrengyl on the upper level of Fandral Staghelm's towering residence in the Cenarion Enclave opens the door to deeper mysteries. To serve nature properly, a druid must learn to embody its living creatures rather than merely observing them. Mathrengyl welcomes candidates with the news that their first great undertaking will be embracing the strength, endurance, and spirit of the bear—a journey that will take them far beyond Teldrassil to sacred ancestral grounds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It has come to my attention that Mathrengyl Bearwalker has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. Mathrengyl is the direct assistant to the Arch Druid himself, and is one of the most sage and august druids you'll find in Teldrassil.
He is located in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus, on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you found your way here today, young druid. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.
